one_line: Fictional banking app with agent-mediated, confirmation-bound financial workflows.

leverage_rationale: Structured tools, exact previews, version binding, expiry and invariants make high-consequence banking interaction materially safer and more precise than UI-driving automation.

prepare-confirm-commit flow with fresh visible confirmation
single-use authorizations bound to preview and state version
execution_rationale: The packet describes a broad, coherent fictional bank and the frame sheet shows consistent landing, login and dashboard states, though no end-to-end mutation is visibly demonstrated.
execution_evidence: consistent ATC banking screens and dashboard
accounts, activity, payments, controls and reporting described
demo alive and public repository
impact_rationale: It targets a real usability and safety problem in banking, especially for older and first-time users, while clearly constraining itself to fictional money.
impact_evidence: explicit audience of older and first-time users
creativity_rationale: The authority-preserving, confirmation-first banking interaction is a thoughtful and ambitious application of agent tooling.

arithmetic challenge for higher-consequence actions

one_line: Physics inquiry lab where an agent proposes experiments and the learner controls approval.

leverage_rationale: The agent reads authoritative live experimental state and proposals are revision-bound and approval-gated; a general UI agent could not reliably reproduce this shared-state tutoring loop.
leverage_evidence: agent sees exact live bench, trials, stage and revision
learner-owned hypothesis and conclusion are tool-inaccessible
stale_revision atomically rejects outdated proposals
execution_rationale: The packet presents a complete 15-minute inquiry arc and the frames show a substantial lab workflow, but no video is submitted and end-to-end behavior is claimed rather than observed.

consistent LabMate experiment screens and charts
demo alive
impact_rationale: It directly addresses a real tutoring failure mode: agents doing the thinking and tutors reasoning from stale summaries, while preserving learner agency.

one_line: Shift scheduler where an agent proposes a compliant weekly rota and a manager approves it.
what_it_does: Analyzes coverage, labor rules and cost, stages assignments as a preview, and records every tool call while withholding any commit tool from the agent.
leverage_rationale: Structured rule-engine access and staged, auditable proposals materially improve reliability for a high-consequence scheduling task compared with UI automation.
leverage_evidence: agent can propose whole week but cannot commit
coverage, breaches and cost shown before approval
tool schemas and call logs are visible/exportable
execution_rationale: The packet shows a coherent domain model with staffing, compliance, cost and approval states; gallery evidence supports a developed dashboard, though no video is submitted.
execution_evidence: 14 staff and seven-day rota scenario
73% coverage, unfilled slots and rest-rule breach
light/dark UI and tool audit described
impact_rationale: Managers have a concrete, recurring scheduling burden and staff welfare depends on avoiding coverage and rest-rule errors.
creativity_rationale: The product makes checking and consent—not autonomous admin—the central interaction, a strong and well-pursued framing.
creativity_evidence: no-commit-tool design rule
before/after approval surface
rota framed as a promise to staff
usability_note: Dense schedule plus explicit deltas and violations appears practical for managers.
red_flags: No submitted video; central agent invocation is packet-claimed
advance_reason: Very strong practical impact, execution and agent-safe workflow.

impact_evidence: critical facility loads and reserve threshold
